prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium shot. A family seen from behind, their faces never visible, in ankle-length rough undyed wool robes and head-cloths, barefoot, sitting close together on a green hillside at evening, the low sun throwing long shadows. Evening, warm low sun. Sobering. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
